```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
pred_loadings <- read.csv(here::here("output/pred_loadings.csv"))
predictors_detailed <- read.csv(here::here("output/predictors_detailed.csv"))
```

```{r, results='asis'}
# Shrink margins for all tables using longtable's built-in controls
cat("\\setlength{\\LTleft}{-1cm}\\setlength{\\LTright}{-1cm}\n")
cat("\\setlength{\\LTpre}{2pt}\\setlength{\\LTpost}{2pt}\n")

cat("\\widowpenalty=10000\n")
cat("\\clubpenalty=10000\n")

library(kableExtra)

# Préparer les données
table_loadings <- pred_loadings %>%
  mutate(across(Co1:Co4, ~ round(.x, 3))) %>% 
  left_join(predictors_detailed %>% select(title, var_id)) %>%
  rename(
    Category   = category,
    Variable   = title,
    ID = var_id,
    `Axis 1`   = Co1,
    `Axis 2`   = Co2,
    `Axis 3`   = Co3,
    `Axis 4`   = Co4
  ) %>% 
  select(Category, Variable, ID, everything()) 

table_loadings_kbl <- table_loadings

# Repérer les lignes à colorer en rouge par axe
red1 <- which(abs(table_loadings_kbl$`Axis 1`) > 0.5)
red2 <- which(abs(table_loadings_kbl$`Axis 2`) > 0.5)
red3 <- which(abs(table_loadings_kbl$`Axis 3`) > 0.5)
red4 <- which(abs(table_loadings_kbl$`Axis 4`) > 0.5)

# Appliquer cell_spec pour les loadings forts
table_loadings_kbl <- table_loadings_kbl %>%
  mutate(
    `Axis 1` = ifelse(abs(`Axis 1`) > 0.5,
      cell_spec(`Axis 1`, color = "#C00000"), as.character(`Axis 1`)),
    `Axis 2` = ifelse(abs(`Axis 2`) > 0.5,
      cell_spec(`Axis 2`, color = "#C00000"), as.character(`Axis 2`)),
    `Axis 3` = ifelse(abs(`Axis 3`) > 0.5,
      cell_spec(`Axis 3`, color = "#C00000"), as.character(`Axis 3`)),
    `Axis 4` = ifelse(abs(`Axis 4`) > 0.5,
      cell_spec(`Axis 4`, color = "#C00000"), as.character(`Axis 4`))
  )

# Alternating category shading — repérer les lignes des catégories paires
unique_cats <- unique(table_loadings$Category)
even_cats <- unique_cats[c(FALSE, TRUE)]
stripe_rows <- which(table_loadings$Category %in% even_cats)

# Groupes pour pack_rows
groups <- table_loadings %>%
  mutate(row = row_number()) %>%
  group_by(Category) %>%
  summarise(start = min(row), end = max(row), .groups = "drop")

# Supprimer la colonne Category (remplacée par pack_rows)
table_display <- table_loadings_kbl %>% select(-Category)

# Construire le tableau
tbl <- table_display %>%
  kbl(
    booktabs  = TRUE,
    longtable = TRUE,
    escape    = FALSE,  # important pour cell_spec
    label     = NA,
    caption   = "Table S1. PCoA variable loadings by category. Values represent correlations between each variable and the principal coordinate axes. Strong loadings (|r| > 0.5) are shown in red."
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("repeat_header"),
    font_size = 10
  ) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, background = "gray!30") %>%
  row_spec(stripe_rows, background = "gray!8") %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "7cm") %>%   # Variable
  column_spec(2, width = "1.5cm") %>% # ID
  column_spec(3, width = "1.5cm") %>% # Axis 1
  column_spec(4, width = "1.5cm") %>% # Axis 2
  column_spec(5, width = "1.5cm") %>% # Axis 3
  column_spec(6, width = "1.5cm")     # Axis 4

# Ajouter les groupes de catégories
for (i in 1:nrow(groups)) {
  tbl <- tbl %>%
    pack_rows(groups$Category[i], groups$start[i], groups$end[i],
              bold = TRUE, background = "gray!30")
}

tbl

  
  
cat("\\clearpage\n")  # new page after each table

```
